thread.title: Cramer Anticipated Flawed Apple Forecast - TheStreet

author: Ari Fima
title: Cramer Anticipated Flawed Apple Forecast - TheStreet
text:
Shares of Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) plunged as CEO Tim Cook pre-announced weakened guidance yesterday.
The announcement, which was anticipated by Jim Cramer in December , during his monthly ActionAlertsPLUS.com Members Only call, included a reduction in guidance for the smartphone leader's fiscal first-quarter 2019 revenue to $84 billion, down from the $89 billion-$93 billion range guided for on the previous earnings release and meaningfully below the analyst consensus of $91.49 billion.
TheStreet's Eric Jhonsa reported on the key takeaways from the announcement, most notably how the trade war with China is affecting iPhone sales.
